🎙️ Reporter: "What do you think about the situation at your employer?"

🗣️ Haaland: "The situation? What year was this? The investigation covered 2009 to 2018.

In 2016, I moved up to Bryne's first team, second team and youth team. In 2017, I went to Molde. In 2018, I was with Molde, the first team, Molde 2 and a bit with the youth team.

candidates.text:
i cannot help but be furious at how the patriarchal and misogynistic society a lot of us grew up in has massively, massively damaged my mother's life. 

i can see how she was never allowed to have her own sense of self. and it breaks my heart every day.

ever since she got married, her entire life has revolved around taking care of our home, taking care of my father who was sick most of the time, and taking care of her only child (me)

the society she grew up in conditioned her to believe that this is all that a woman is supposed to do. heck, she still finds it hard to accept that she *can* have opinions or a choice about most things. 

she never allowed herself to 'like' and 'dislike' things throughout her life, because a 'good woman' is 'obedient' and listens to her husband.

while my father was still around, most of her day was spent just taking care of him and doing chores. but what now? she has all the time in the world but her brain does not even think of leisure or personal interests as an option. she feels utterly lost. she has no sense of self

because she was never allowed to see herself as an individual with personal interests. the society around made her believe that she is only a device of sacrifice for her husband, her family, and her child

i keep trying my best to encourage her to read, to meet her friends, to watch new shows, to go out more often, to eat new food, to come on trips with me. i will keep trying my best to put a smile on her face. there is nothing that hurts more than seeing her lost and hopeless

but i honestly don't know if it will be enough. there is so much damage done already 

fuck patriarchy. fuck you if you think this is ok

fin
